sentences.en: Such skills could be put to many practical uses.
sentences.zh: 这些技能可以有很多实际用途。

sentences.en: The English are said to be a practical people.
sentences.zh: 据说英国人是很实用的人。

sentences.en: The president gave up the idea because it was not practical.
sentences.zh: 因为这个想法不切实际，总统放弃了它。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：practic(e)（实践）+al（…的）→实践的
